Du lieu uu tien de doc may, vi vay moi y tuong duoc chia thanh cac khoi trung voi cac phan tren the chi tiet.
Agent co the render 1 the tong quan tu quick_card va 1 the chi tiet tu detail_card.
Cac y tuong duoc uu tien theo tieu chi: san pham vat ly/handmade, de bat dau, khong can gioi cong nghe, co the kiem them thu nhap.
